echo_summons.title: The letter that found you
echo_summons.text:
To whoever finds this,

The lamps of Veyl went out a hundred years ago, and no one has ever asked why. I think you might.

Come to the Lamplighters' Guildhall and knock at the night door. Bring a lantern. The door opens only for someone who knows who is waiting behind it.

- P.

echo_notice.title: Notice on the board
echo_notice.text:
NOTICE
By order of the Council, the Lamplighters' Guildhall is closed to the public after dusk.
All enquiries to the Council Warden at the Beacon Tower.
After dark, ring at the night door. Night porter: P. Pell.

The paper is a hundred years old. Someone has underlined the last line.

echo_letter.title: Unsent letter
echo_letter.text:
Ilsa,

Orren insists you take the valve watch tonight. Third bell, as always. Whatever he says, don't let him talk you into lighting the beacon early. The Council is watching all of us now.

- M.

echo_logbook.title: Valve watch logbook
echo_logbook.text:
Dusk. Archive sealed by order of the Council. Not our business, they say.
Midnight. Pressure steady. Inspected, O. Hale.
Third bell. Watch handed to I. Varn.

The rest of the page has been torn out.

echo_drawing.title: Chalk drawing
echo_drawing.text:
A child's drawing on the foyer wall. A woman with a lantern hangs from an enormous wheel, turning it with her whole weight. Around her, every lamp in the city is drawn as a black circle.

Underneath, in careful letters: THE VALVE LADY MADE THE NIGHT.

Below that, in an adult's hand, four numbers have been rubbed out too badly to read.
